definitions.explanation: An organ or group of cells in the body that produces and secretes substances such as hormones, sweat, or saliva. Used in medical and biological contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{甲状|こうじょう}{腺|せん}→甲状腺：23860_koujousen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had my thyroid gland examined.

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}{腺|せん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Sweat is secreted from the sweat glands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}→唾液腺：27747_daekisen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My salivary glands are swollen and I feel pain when eating, so I decided to go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
Rarely used alone; almost always appears as a suffix combined with the type of gland. Note the kanji {腺|せん} contains the {月|にくづき} radical (flesh/body) plus ⟦{泉|いずみ}→泉：01787_izumi⟧ (spring), reflecting its meaning as a bodily source of fluids.
